edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Irregular sleep disrupts circadian timing across metabolism, autonomic tone, and endocrine signaling, which is why it can matter even when average sleep duration looks adequate.
edges.summary: For all-cause mortality, the most useful starting point is the 2025 Kalkanis systematic review in Sleep Med Rev. It found that low sleep regularity tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes, and the follow-on evidence is broadly consistent even when absolute benefit or harm is modest.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
